---
title: "Getting started"
---

Start by [**installing rig**](install.qmd). Then pick the walkthrough that
fits you; each one takes you from your first R installation with rig, to
running R and installing packages.

See [Admin mode vs user mode](admin-vs-user-mode.qmd) for more details
on the two modes and how to pick between them.

1. [**As an R user**](tutorial-user.qmd) \
   rig installs everything into your home directory (user mode) and does
   not need an administrator account. Use it if you have no administrator
   rights, or do not want R in system directories. It is a newer mode, and
   less tested than admin mode, especially on Linux.

2. [**As an R admin**](tutorial-admin.qmd) \
   R is installed system-wide (admin mode) and shared by everyone on the
   machine. You need an administrator account to do this, and rig asks for
   your password when it needs to. This is rig's default mode, and the
   better tested one.

3. [**Migrating to user mode**](tutorial-migrate.qmd) \
   You already have an admin-mode rig setup and want to move it into your
   home directory.
